title: Eleven weeks at St. Paul, Minnesota
summary: Daily schedule of excursions and night dancing during the upriver stay.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Working the Streckfus riverboats with Fate Marable

blocks.x: Once a week, every Tuesday morning, 10 o'clock. When we was in St. Paul, Minnesota, we had to be awake on the bandstand for 9.30 to start at 10. And we used to come down the rivers for us, Haston, Minnesota, to the locks, go through the locks, turn around and come back, and then get back to St. Paul, Minnesota, and land for 5 o'clock. And then be right back on the bandstand for 8, and knock off at 12. But when we was in St. Paul, he eliminated some of those rehearsals. Because that was too rough. Yeah. Every day, and we stayed with-
They played daytime excursions there too? Daytime and night. And night.
Night dancing. And we did that, we stayed there 11 months.
In St. Paul. Was there much dancing in the daytime or did-
No, they didn't dance too much. But you did play, you had to play. We had to play, whether they danced or not. Yeah. We just had to play. But at night, nice crowds.
